rules.sentence: In tricuspid regurgitation, lesions fall into 2 categories: primary, where intrinsic abnormalities in the tricuspid valvular apparatus are responsible, and secondary, where right atrial or ventricular dilatation causes tricuspid regurgitation.
The most common cause of tricuspid regurgitation is secondary or functional regurgitation.

Secondary disorders like tricuspid annular dilation and leaflet tethering in right ventricular pressure and volume overload are largely responsible for tricuspid regurgitation compared to primary disorders involving the valve apparatus.[6][7][8]
